method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Colour stops with location
features.detail: add, move, delete stops on a bar
features.verse_evidence: "Colour stops: Colour Opacity Position %", "Add a stop"; click the bar to add

features.name: Radial size / shape
features.verse_evidence: Ellipse / Circle; no size keyword (closest-side, farthest-corner) or centre position

features.name: Live preview with adjustable size
features.detail: preview box resized to the element size
features.verse_evidence: preview with "Your text here"; no preview width/height control

features.name: Colour format
features.detail: hex, rgb, rgba, hsl, hsla in the CSS

features.name: Import from CSS
features.detail: paste a gradient to edit it
features.verse_evidence: "Import CSS: edit a gradient you have"

features.name: Import from image
features.detail: make a gradient from a picture
features.verse_evidence: "Read it or take the colours from a picture"

features.name: Save your own presets
features.detail: keep gradients you made in the preset list
features.verse_evidence: Your gradients: Save as preset keeps a named gradient on this device, each with a remove button, opened with one tap

features.name: Named gradients
features.detail: give a gradient a name used in the output
features.verse_evidence: Name: the name goes into the CSS as a comment and a class (.brand-hero) and into SCSS variable names

features.name: Old-browser output (IE filter, -webkit-, maximize compatibility)
features.detail: vendor prefixes and an IE filter fallback
features.verse_evidence: a fallback background colour (the stops' average); no prefixed or IE filter lines

features.name: Eyedropper and colour picker (ColorZilla extension)
features.detail: pick colours from any page with the browser add-on
features.verse_evidence: Pick a colour from the screen (the EyeDropper API, Chrome and Edge on a computer) into the chosen stop; no browser extension

features.name: Repeating gradients
features.verse_evidence: imported repeating gradients are read (lib/gradient.js line 67) but written without repeating

verse_extra: Worst text contrast across the whole gradient
Opens offline; no ads, trackers or social widgets
Fallback colour computed from the stops
